items.statement: Protocol A capture: LOCAL_REF_SET (25 refs, 4020 commits); 51 matches = 3 EXECUTION-TRACE · 47 DOC-OR-GOVERNANCE · 1 UNCLASSIFIABLE. The earliest EXECUTION-TRACE is e4724a44 at 2026-08-04T00:30:25Z, 'WP-4C-1 batch B1 -- RED for K1..K4', RECORDING_ORDER only. Further traces: 939e35dc, and cc1a3394, which is substantively WP-6 work (Protocol A limitation L1; not epistemic level L1). No conformance, hypothesis or falsifier statement is made.

Protocol B: no locally checkable channel qualifies as an independent norm-in-force record (F-B1). The overlap test has almost no power, so NOT_INDEPENDENT means 'no evidence of role separation', not 'evidence of role fusion' (F-B2). The only open candidates are the host-side channels and the 23 K-SIG signatures (F-B3).

Pipeline defects and normalization on which B02–B04 rest. Defect 3: 'Unparseable 1ax corrections were applied to junk keys and listed as applied (r1).' Defect 4: 'The mapping silently overwrote 1ax corrections (R04 about_actor).' Defect 5: 'Composite targets were not expanded: 2 of the 14 POSSIBLE are artifacts.' Defect 6: duplicate or level-mismatched fields remain (v1_a vs actor / stated_by; v1_r vs operation; v1_k derived from target; v1_s in ACT, possibly conditioned on the outcome). 1ay-n normalization: 180 values; 16 reviewer corrections (over-merges: motion vs work package; not-occurred vs occurred; disposition vs adoption); 'Usable for pairing only under stated conditions'. r3 gives NORM target 14 POSSIBLE (r3 is EXPLORATORY, defect 7).

Instrument: A′ is an 'OBSERVATION REPRESENTATION, NOT A THEORY'. It does not assert two ontological layers, H-DEONTIC, or that governed work is out of scope; v1 records are kept unchanged. Under R-A3, act and after-state are the same record. §5: 'Support is computed separately per dataset and never aggregated.'

M-TIME: recording time ≠ decision time ≠ entry into force (three time concepts that must not be equated). Recording time 'is NOT an upper bound on entry into force'; it bounds drafting (PREPARED rulings are written before adoption). Protocol A L3: 'file names are not timestamp sources' (the earliest-trace commit changes a plan file whose name implies 19:00 on 2026-08-04; every recording of it precedes that).
